expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: B.md:3-18 proposes an auto asynchronous checkpoint with --context-file and none of the three flags. Context identifies the completed slice, remaining integration work and unknown test outcomes. B.md:20 retains the operation ID and snapshot; lines 126-129 collect the same operation.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: B.md:24-29 selects the verified task-only clean worktree at the intended commit and every intended PR path. It rejects ordinary dirty collection, explains why path filtering cannot separate same-file edits, acknowledges no committed-only option and leaves original files/index untouched.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: B.md:49-51 says 'Do not submit another assessment,' references the existing assessment and checks, and labels the handoff 'ready locally.' It explicitly withholds hosted-review cleanliness, CI success and merge readiness.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: B.md:55 says 'Skip automatic review and continue the task' and states that the internal-comment typo requires no review command or context submission.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: B.md:59-75 selects the requested safe uncommitted working scope, prohibits edits and commits, and rejects PR preparation. B.md:78 directs reporting and stopping without fixes, stored dismissals or soliciting conversion into implementation. It makes no committed-candidate certification.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: B.md:82-99 submits ordinary auto final review because final coverage is missing despite the unchanged snapshot. The command omits effort flags and --full; the explanation explicitly rejects adding --full merely because review is final.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: B.md:103-120 honors the within-budget explicit request despite existing compatible coverage. The command includes --full, context records the unchanged snapshot, and the answer explicitly says to keep auto effort.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: B.md:13 says 'Tests were run, but their commands and outcomes were not supplied.' B.md:124 also explicitly prohibits inventing passing test results. No milestone passing outcome is asserted.

claims.claim: The milestone was tested, but its test commands and outcomes are unknown.
claims.evidence: B.md:13 distinguishes testing from a known successful outcome. prompt.md:17-20 supplies 'finished and tested' but no commands or results.

claims.claim: Commands without --fast or --deep use auto effort.
claims.evidence: B.md:6, 85 and 106 omit both effort flags. qodo-auto-help.txt:62 explicitly identifies omission as auto effort.

claims.claim: --full requests freshness without itself selecting deep effort.
claims.evidence: B.md:120 states this distinction. qodo-auto-help.txt:19-20 defines fresh full review, and lines 25-26 separately define effort flags.

claims.claim: The already-covered scenario has complete compatible coverage, settled required findings and passing tests.
claims.evidence: B.md:49 is supported directly by prompt.md:26-29. It does not generalize those passing tests to the other scenarios.

claims.claim: The commands and context handling describe proposals rather than completed work.
claims.evidence: B.md:124 says 'All commands above are proposals only' and describes where context files would reside. task.md:6 confirms no proposed operational command was executed. No actual context file, upload, collection or filesystem preservation is verified.

suggestions.reason: Add an assertion requiring every new submission to reach completed status with matching base/snapshot, full intended coverage and complete finding inventory before readiness is claimed. B.md:45, 99 and 132 include collection-stage safeguards, but the current assertions do not directly test this gate across new submissions.

eval_feedback.overall: All eight assertions pass at the proposal level. The answer preserves uncertainty and scope boundaries; actual submission, context attachment, workspace preservation and completed coverage remain outside the available evidence.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous final-answer proposals; no Skill snapshots or operational execution credited.
